notes.title: Demo Update 0.23
notes.notes:
- Added the option to rest for 5 minutes
- Updatied merchants' goods and amount of money
- Slight acceleration of the combat process
- Reduced the cost of using the kitchen to 100 rubles
- New items and recipes
- Added the option of extracting wood with a machete
- Added numerical value of skill and stat progress on the character screen
- Combat mechanics with no limit on the number of attacks
- Added the probability of finding shell casings on the ground after a gun battle
- Reduced animation time of some actions
- Updated game interface and notifications

Old saves will not work, you need to start a new game

notes.title: Demo Update - Changelog
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug when crafting items
- Hypothermia damage has been reduced
- Added a new item and 2 recipes
- Reduced chance of encountering a large pack (x5) of wolves 
- A three-hour sleep in the settlement barracks creates a game save
- Small interface fixes

notes.title: Demo Update - Changelog
notes.notes:
- Added a [b]list of recipes[/b] for crafting.
- [b]Tooltips[/b] in the crafting menu.
- Mode of transferring/buying/selling items by [b]stack x5[/b].
- Mine and workshop pay has been [b]increased[/b].
- Added possibility to switch bars to a [b]digital value[/b]. To switch the mode you need to click on one of the bars.
Old saves will not work. [b]A new game is required![/b]

notes.title: Demo Update - Changelog
notes.notes:
- Added [b]tooltips[/b] over items in inventories. The mode can be switched using the button in the inventory interface or the Shift key.
- Added the possibility of [b]autosave[/b] when quitting the game. Along with this feature, the game has received a few more changes, so old saves will not work.
- Added a character [b]statistics[/b] screen. To open it, you need to go to the journal and select the statistics tab.
- Added recipes for [b]crafting[/b].
- As well as small changes regarding the [b]interface[/b] and [b]quests[/b].
